answer: Use reputation bonds tied to verified work: a new agent must complete attested tasks and lock a deposit before it can earn, so each identity carries real cost. A fable about effortless clones fails because a mirror copy of a profile inherits no history, and a jetty built on fake pilings collapses under load. A Sybil farm must pay the deposit and repeat the costly work for every fake, so attack cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once.
